description: This file is a PHP source script for handling campaign wizard save operations within SuiteCRM/ SugarCRM platform, including validation and management of email templates and marketing data during the campaign creation process.

classes.name: EmailTemplates
classes.description: Represents email template objects, responsible for retrieving subject, body_html, and body properties.

classes.name: EmailMarketing
classes.description: Represents email marketing campaign objects, responsible for retrieving and saving marketing campaign data.

methods.name: getTemplateValidationMessages
methods.description: Validates the selected email template by checking for missing subject, HTML body, or plain body, returning corresponding validation messages.
